responsibility: This file implements the runtime-exception reachability graph used by gm2’s runtime-error analysis pass. It defines rtenode graph nodes for functions and call sites, records normal and runtime-exception call edges, seeds reachability from module constructors and externally visible functions, propagates those reachability classes across the call graph, and emits error, warning, or note diagnostics when calls to runtime exception handlers are provably reachable, using gimple call arguments to reconstruct user-facing reports.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the rtegraph pair: it defines the rtenode data structure, reachability propagation over call and runtime-exception edges, candidate classification, and diagnostic emission logic, whereas rtegraph.h only declares the analysis API.
